text:
The assistant provides a correct and efficient binary search solution with O(1) space and O(log(min(n, m))) time, which is actually better than the requested O(n) time. However, it incorrectly claims that O(n) time with O(1) space is impossible; a simple two-pointer linear scan can achieve O(n) time and O(1) space. The code is correct and well-explained, but the false impossibility statement reduces accuracy.

Rating: [[7]]
